headline: Iran Declares Full Offensive as US Considers Nuclear Options
subheadline: IRGC coordinates regional militias while Islamabad agreement expires, raising direct confrontation risks.
lede: Iran has shifted to a full offensive posture and set a multi-week deadline for US negotiations, according to intelligence sources. The 60-day Islamabad agreement between Iran and the US has expired without a specific agreement being reached. High-ranking IRGC generals held secret online meetings with Hezbollah, Houthi, and pro-Iranian militia commanders to discuss expanding the war. The US is reportedly considering a nuclear strike on Iran following the expiration of peace agreements.

sections.title: Russia Expands UAV Infrastructure Across Borders
sections.body: Russian forces liberated Novosoloshino village in Zaporizhzhia region while launching massive UAV waves across Ukraine including Kyiv, Sumy, Dnipro, and Odesa regions. Ukraine's Patriot air defense systems are nearly out of interceptor missiles with one launcher unfired for six weeks. Russia has built at least 10 new UAV launch bases along Ukrainian and Belarusian borders with 59 identified launch rails. Russian air defenses are intercepting nearly all Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missiles with only 1-2 of 11 FP-5 missiles reaching targets recently due to A-50U early-warning aircraft deployment since July.

sections.title: Iran Shifts to Offensive Posture
sections.body: Iran has reportedly decided to shift from a defensive posture to a full offensive posture and set a deadline of several weeks for the full implementation of a memorandum of understanding with the US. The 60-day period of the Islamabad agreement between Iran and the US has expired without a specific agreement being reached. High-ranking IRGC generals reportedly held secret online meetings with Hezbollah, Houthi, and pro-Iranian militia commanders to discuss expanding the war. The Israeli Prime Minister's office claims an agreement was reached with the Gaza Peace Council regarding Hamas disarmament.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's transition to an offensive posture combined with the expiration of the Islamabad agreement significantly elevates confrontation risks. The coordination between IRGC and regional militias suggests a synchronized effort to expand the conflict across multiple theaters. Russia's expanded UAV infrastructure and degraded Patriot systems create critical vulnerabilities in Ukraine's defensive capabilities.
